name: WBN SEO Infrastructure
author: atircohen

sections.description:
WBN SEO Infrastructure is not another “meta title manager.” It’s an infrastructure layer that organizes indexability, structured data output, and SEO health, then gives you clear diagnostics and a controlled schema preview.

  • SEO Audit — Score, breakdown (Meta / Content / Links / Schema), pass/fix checks, and suggested meta for any page.
  • Apply — Save suggested title and description to the page in one click (Safe Override).
  • Reports — Generate a basic PDF report (email required).
  • Schema & meta — Template-based generation, preview, and integration with Yoast/Rank Math when present.

Use it alongside your existing SEO plugin. It doesn’t replace Yoast, Rank Math, or AIOSEO — it organizes what they can’t.

External services

URL validation

When you click “Validate (HTTP 200 + Schema)” in the plugin admin, the plugin makes an HTTP request to the URL of the selected page on your own site to verify it returns a 200 response. No data is sent to third-party servers during this check.

Privacy

The plugin stores audit data (snapshots) in your WordPress database. No data is sent to external servers.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install via WordPress admin (Plugins → Add New → Upload).
  2. Activate “WBN SEO Infrastructure”.
  3. Go to SEO Infrastructure in the admin menu.
  4. Select a page, click Load, then Scan to run an audit. Use Apply to save suggested meta.
sections.faq:
Do I need a license key?

No. Additional advanced features are available in the Pro version.
